'''Tough group''' was a group of three [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

They attempted to [[Skirmish at Outpost D-34|prevent]] the capture of ''[[Onece 3]]'' but were destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces of [[Outpost D-34]].

==Behind the scenes==
These ships only appear in the Hard difficulty on Battle 1 mission 1.
